title: Venus’s ex is on our couch.
caption: Mars crashes on Aries and Libra's couch and keeps asking about Venus. They let him stay, with one kind boundary: no ex talk at dinner. Other people's drama doesn't have to become yours. Send this to the roommate who hosts everyone.
